pokeball.name: Poké Ball
pokeball.description: Try to catch a defeated opponent, then choose a team slot to replace. Catch rates: N 90%, R 60%, SR 30%, SSR 10%, UR 1%. Bosses cannot be caught.

finger.name: Sukuna’s Finger
finger.description: Adds one Host of Sukuna stack. At 5: King of Poison. At 10: Cleave. At 15: Incomplete Malevolent Shrine. At 20: incarnate as Sukuna, upgrading both attacks. Stacks are lost on replacement.

coin.name: Tattoed Inmate Skin
coin.description: Each skin guides to treasure, raising the minimum favorites filter for victory rerolls by 10. Stacks.

senzubean.name: Senzu Bean (WIP)
senzubean.description: On consumption, increase 1 life. Unable to use when at full life.

greatball.name: Great Ball
greatball.description: Try to catch a defeated opponent. Catch rates: N 100%, R 80%, SR 50%, SSR 30%, UR 5%. Bosses cannot be caught.

radar.name: Dragon Ball Radar
radar.description: SSR rewards have a 40% chance to be a Dragon Ball. One per player.

longinus.name: Spear of Longinus
longinus.description: Attacks ignore 40% of the target’s Defense.

swordfish.name: Swordfish II
swordfish.description: Grants +25 Speed and a 10% chance to dodge incoming attacks.

drug.name: Quirk-Destroying Drug
drug.description: Choose and permanently remove one of a unit’s passive abilities.

curse.name: Curse Devil Nail
curse.description: ATB fills 20% slower. After three hits on the same target, it loses 50% of maximum HP (15% for bosses). Resets after each trigger; every three hits can trigger it again.

whistle.name: White Whistle
whistle.description: Gives the strongest other ally +5% of every base stat. Uses base BST; ties go to the first ally. Copies stack.

ultraball.name: Ultra Ball
ultraball.description: Try to catch a defeated opponent. Catch rates: N 100%, R 100%, SR 80%, SSR 50%, UR 10%. Bosses cannot be caught.

dragonball.name: Dragon Ball
dragonball.description: Collect seven to summon Shenlong and wish for a character of your choosing. Seven Dragon Balls are consumed per wish.

inverted.name: Inverted Spear of Heaven
inverted.description: Grants +20 Attack. Attacks inflict NEGATED for 6 seconds, suppressing passive abilities and keywords. Reapplication refreshes the duration.

journal.name: Grandpa’s Hissatsu Journal
journal.description: Permanently grants Taunt. Enemies prioritize this unit. Taunt does not stack.

rokkakaka.name: Rokkakaka Fruit
rokkakaka.description: Permanently sacrifices a unit for a random item of the same rarity. Cannot be used on N units.

arrow.name: Stand Arrow
arrow.description: 70% chance to grant a new implemented passive; 30% chance to permanently kill the unit. Maximum three passives per unit.

merry.name: Going Merry
merry.description: Permanently adds one team slot, filled with a random character. One per player.

mask.name: Stone Mask
mask.description: Permanently grants Lifesteal: attacks restore HP equal to half the actual damage dealt. Does not stack.

masterball.name: Master Ball
masterball.description: Catch any defeated non-boss opponent without fail, then choose a team slot to replace.

stone.name: Philosopher’s Stone
stone.description: Victory rerolls cannot produce a lower-rarity unit than the unit being replaced. One per player.

hogyoku.name: Hōgyoku
hogyoku.description: At battle start, suppresses all of the wearer’s passive abilities and keywords for this battle. Grants +25 to all stats per suppressed passive. Traits remain visible.

potara.name: Potara Earrings
potara.description: Equip one on each of two units to fuse them. Each stat becomes 75% of their combined values. Inherits the first passive, keyword and non-Potara equipment item of each; uses the higher rarity.

machine.name: Future Machine No. 8
machine.description: On the first loss in each encounter, restarts the battle without losing a life. Stage and ability state reset. The relic is kept.

behelit.name: Behelit
behelit.description: At battle start, kills every other participating ally. Grants +25 to all stats per ally killed, for this battle. Death-triggered abilities still activate.

sunny.name: Thousand Sunny
sunny.description: Permanently adds one team slot, filled with a random character. One per player.
